dct_description_sm: # Morocco Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Sep 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Morocco Earthquake (Sep 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Morocco, Earthquake, 11 Sep 2023, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Morocco, Earthquake, 11 Sep 2023, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Morocco, Earthquake, 11 Sep 2023, v0.5** (superseded) **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2023), Validated with FirstLook Imagery Â© 2023 Maxar
